# -- Team to agency mapping --
First, we are creating a list from schedules to get unique teams
matching their state or city

```{r}
# This should give out a human readable unique team name 
# matched with their city or state

unique_name <- sched %>%
  select(season, home_team, away_team) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(home_team, away_team),
    names_to = "team_role",
    values_to = "team_name"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    team_name = str_squish(team_name), # for text cleanup
    team_key  = team_name %>%
      str_to_lower() %>% # make case consistent, uppercase or lowercase don't matter
      str_replace_all("[^a-z0-9 ]", "") # remove punctuation/symbols
  ) %>%
  distinct(team_name, team_key) %>% # keep unique team name with key pairs (remove duplicates from repeated games)
  arrange(team_name) # sort alphabetically

# save it in a csv file
write_csv(unique_name, "team_unik.csv")
```

Second, we create a list to match each ORI code with the corresponding college town 

```{r}
header <- read_csv("nibrs_batch_header_1991_2024.csv")
```

```{r}
paper_cities <- tibble(
    city_name=c("akron", "ames", "ann arbor","athens","austin","Blacksburg","boise","clemson","Colorado Springs",
    "Columbia","Columbus","Denton","East Lansing","Fayetteville","Huntington","Iowa City","Jonesboro",
    "Kalamazoo","Lawrence","Logan","Lubbock","Morgantown","Moscow","Mount Pleasant","Murfreesboro","Provo"),
    state_abbreviation=c("oh", "ia","mi","oh","tx","va","id","sc","co","sc","oh","tx","mi","ar","wv","ia","ar","mi",
    "ks","ut","tx","wv","id","mi","tn","ut"),
    school=c("the university of akron", "iowa state university","the university of michigan","ohio university",
        "the University of Texas at Austin","Virginia Polytechnic Institute and State University","Boise State University",
        "Clemson University","United States Air Force Academy","The University of South Carolina","The Ohio State University",
        "The University of North Texas","Michigan State University","University of Arkansas","Marshall University",
        "The University of Iowa","Arkansas State University","Western Michigan University","The University of Kansas",
        "Utah State University","Texas Tech University","West Virginia University","The University of Idaho",
        "Eastern Michigan University","Middle Tennessee State University","Brigham Young University")
) %>%
    mutate(across(everything(), ~ str_to_lower(as.character(.)))) %>%
    mutate(team=c("Akron","Iowa State","Michigan","Ohio","Texas","Virginia Tech","Boise State","Clemson",
        "Air Force","South Carolina","Ohio State","North Texas","Michigan State","Arkansas","Marshall","Iowa",
        "Arkansas State","Western Michigan","Kansas","Utah State","Texas Tech","West Virginia","Idaho",
        "Eastern Michigan","Middle Tennessee","BYU")) 
```

```{r}
head <- header %>%
    filter(year == "2000") %>%
    select(c("ori","city_name","state_abbreviation","agency_indicator")) %>%
    unique()
```

```{r}
s2<- sched %>%
    select(c("home_team")) %>% 
    unique()
```
 
```{r}
ori_mapping <- left_join(paper_cities, head, by=c("city_name","state_abbreviation")) %>% 
    filter(agency_indicator=="city")

write_csv(ori_mapping, "ori_mapping.csv")
```
